top_signals.title: Katayama to Say Japan, US Are Coordinating to Curb Yen Weakness
top_signals.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama is set to announce as early as Monday that Tokyo and Washington are coordinating on steps in the foreign exchange market to curb the yen’s weakness, a person familiar with the situation said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Survivors battle heat over first weekend since Kumamoto quake
top_signals.summary: A woman in her 70s died of suspected heatstroke while sheltering in her car, in what is believed to be a "disaster-related death" of the disaster.

top_signals.title: Dodgers land 2-time Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal in trade with Tigers
top_signals.summary: The Dodgers' need for pitching depth ramped up in the last few weeks with two-way star Shohei Ohtani sidelined from pitching due to knee inflammation and bicep soreness.
